scripts.dev: node init && npm run build -w @aurzen/shared && npm run build -w @aurzen/api && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.development.local scripts/dev.cjs
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w @aurzen/shared && npm run build -w @aurzen/api && npm run build -w @aurzen/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aurzen/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @aurzen/shared && npm run build -w @aurzen/api && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
